difficulty_reason: The two definitions of pushforward for dg modules along a morphism of ringed sites agree: after the identification of the underlying categories, the author regards (O_C, 0) as a dg algebra concentrated in degree 0, notes Mod(O_C, 0) = Mod(O_C), and concludes that both routes are the right derived extension of the same composite functor, hence equal by uniqueness of adjoints (with lemma-compose-pushforward supplying the underlying comparison). Retained author proof at lines 5398-5448.
